notes.raw_title: feat(scheduling): Bulldog Meet only for MVP; park Teams bridging behind flag
notes.summary: Ship the MVP as **Bulldog Meet only**. The "Join via Teams" affordance was misleading external attendees: signaling worked end-to-end but the bridge bot never actually appeared as a real participant in the Teams meeting (MediaWorker media-plane blocked, no observable logs).
